title: Chapter 286: Each Showing His Special Ability
content:
Chapter 286: Each Showing His Special Ability

The mysterious chariot of the alien race, guarding the five-star heavy cavalry troops and powerful mages of the alien race, stepped into the area where the Zerg puppies were lurking and stood on the heads of the Zerg puppies.

Wu Qing let some Zerg puppies drill out of the ground, and he tested the magical ability of the mysterious chariot in actual combat.

The Zerg puppies drilled out of the ground directly from the protection range of the mysterious chariot. They were not blocked by the energy shield and all entered the protection range of the mysterious chariot smoothly.

Before the Zerg puppies felt the difference, an extremely powerful light attribute energy purified them instantly.

"I don't believe that maintaining this rule-level defense force does not require consumption!"

Wu Qing no longer let the Zerg puppies come out to die. He ordered the Queen of the Zerg to calculate the optimal firepower configuration and use the five-star Zerg destroyer to start attacking the protection range of the mysterious chariot that was constantly approaching.

"Boom boom boom...!"

Under the command of the Queen of the Zerg, tens of thousands of five-star Zerg destroyers attacked continuously in turns, achieving the strongest killing effect.

But such a powerful attack still couldn't break the defense of the mysterious chariot.

"It should be a five-star attack, the upper limit of the lethality is not enough!"

When Wu Qing thought of this, he immediately consumed a lot of resources to upgrade a group of Zerg Explosive Mosquitoes to five stars.

The self-destruction attack of the five-star Zerg Explosive Mosquitoes has a lethality that reaches the limit of six stars, close to the attack of a seven-star strongman.

Moreover, the self-destruction attack power of the Zerg Explosive Mosquitoes has a certain superposition bonus. The more Zerg Explosive Mosquitoes are concentrated together and self-destructed, the more powerful they will be.

The large number of melee arms assembled by the alien human army entered the attack range of the Zerg destroyers at the beginning, rushing towards the territory of the Zerg puppies and the three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions.

"Boom boom boom...!"

More than 100,000 Zerg destroyers ended their rest and began to attack the charging alien human army.

Suddenly, a terrifying magical energy flashed by and rushed into the position of the Zerg main combat arms, which surprised Wu Qing.

This was a powerful light attribute magic energy, which instantly covered the entire Zerg main combat position and the ground in the surrounding area.

Just as Wu Qing was waiting for this suspected large-scale battlefield magic to explode, he found that the magic ended just like that.

The Zerg army felt a little uncomfortable stepping on a layer of light attribute energy, but it had almost no effect on their combat power.

Wu Qing thought of a possibility and immediately let a Zerg Hydralisk drill into the ground. He found that under the obstruction of this light attribute energy, it became very difficult for the Zerg to drill into the ground.

Another powerful wave of magic energy came. Wu Qing saw through the Zerg host that the carriage of the mysterious chariot of the alien race had lost the ability to shield the outside world from detection. The Zerg host had already detected that there were hundreds of alien mages standing in the huge carriage.

It was they who instantly released an auxiliary large-scale battlefield magic, which immediately broke the Zerg army's ability to drill into the ground, and it was very targeted.

The second large-scale battlefield magic was rapidly forming under their leadership and the assistance of more than 2,000 mages outside.

"Mages in the carriage, each of them will spawn twice!"

Wu Qing immediately issued the attack order.

The five hundred five-star Zerg queens who had been on standby immediately used two spawning attacks on the powerful alien mages exposed in the carriage of the mysterious chariot.

The rule-level spawning attack of the Zerg queen ignored the rule-level defense of the mysterious chariot and silently attacked the powerful alien mages in the mysterious chariot.

These alien mages who have been hiding in the mysterious chariot are the real powerful mages. From the fact that they instantly cast a large battlefield magic, it can be seen that they should all be mages with six-star strength.

The seven-star troops are classified as strong and will not participate in the battle here.

The six-star troops are the strongest troops on this battlefield.

Seeing this scene, Wu Qing was not worried, but overjoyed.

More than one hundred six-star mages are exactly the enemies that Wu Qing urgently needs.

As long as these six-star mages of the alien race are killed, even if the war is lost directly, it is worth it.

The Zerg Queen's attack successfully hit the target, and Wu Qing was relieved. He was originally a little worried that the rule power of the mysterious chariot was too strong, which would make the Zerg Queen's attack ineffective.

All the six-star mages of the alien race in the mysterious chariot stopped casting spells and fell into a painful internal confrontation.

But it seems that the mysterious chariot still has the ability to assist in casting spells. After the more than 100 six-star mages who were the main casters stopped casting spells, the large-scale battlefield magic that had been initially formed did not stop, but was successfully performed under the maintenance of the more than 2,000 surviving alien mages.

A powerful magic energy flew straight to the sky, and the sky above the main combat position of the Zerg was dark again.

The large-scale battlefield magic chosen by the alien race this time was still the falling stars. If this magic can attack the Zerg army, the killing effect is very good. This is the experience gained by the alien race from actual combat.

Facing this large-scale battlefield magic again, the Zerg on the main combat unit position can no longer burrow into the ground to escape.

The layer of light attribute energy covering the ground can greatly limit the Zerg's ability to burrow into the ground.

Fortunately, the Zerg Queen attacked in time and did not give the more than 100 six-star mages more time to cast spells.

The final magic of falling stars was much weaker than the first one.

Unavoidable, all arms of the Zerg main combat force stopped attacking and entered a defensive state.

The Zerg in a defensive state will use the most defensive shell on their bodies to face the attack to protect the relatively vulnerable parts of the body.

The Zerg in this state has the strongest defense and recovery capabilities.

The sky-high light attribute energy fell from the sky like rain, landing on the positions of the Zerg main combat forces, bursting into groups of dazzling light.

The aliens finally achieved their combat goal, allowing the Zerg main combat forces to fully withstand the baptism of a large-scale battlefield magic.

The overbearing purification and annihilation energy eroded the body of the Zerg in every possible way. The shells of the weaker Zerg began to disappear bit by bit. The Zerg's powerful self-healing recovery ability was activated, and the magical self-healing recovery energy was trying to recover the injuries of the Zerg bit by bit.

This was a tug-of-war. If the external purification and annihilation energy weakened, the Zerg's self-healing recovery energy would win and the Zerg would survive.

If the external purification and annihilation energy continued to increase, when it reached a certain critical point, the Zerg's self-healing recovery energy could only retreat. As long as this state lasted for a long enough time, the Zerg's body would be fatally injured, and then die and disappear.

The light attribute energy in the sky was like a sky full of stars, falling continuously.

On the positions of the Zerg's main combat arms, the Zerg that entered the defensive state and the one-star arms that were attacked more intensively began to disappear.

The Zerg's main combat arms were reduced in number.

Without the fire suppression of the Zerg Destroyer, a large number of alien melee soldiers rushed into the territory occupied by the Zerg Hounds and Zerg Toxic Ray Scorpions. The Zerg Hounds drilled out of the ground to block them, and the two sides began a bloody melee fight.

The melee soldiers of the alien army came prepared. Their race, soldiers and weapons and equipment have a certain restraint on the Zerg Hounds.

The restraint here does not mean that the Zerg Hounds, a melee all-round soldier, are restrained by them, but that after some adjustments, they can suffer less losses when fighting with the Zerg Hounds.

The alien long-range combat soldiers stuck at the edge of the Zerg Destroyer's range immediately moved forward quickly and launched a fierce long-range attack on the Zerg Hounds.

The three-type Zerg Toxic Ray Scorpions just came out of the ground and fired a few rounds of poisonous rays, and were suppressed by a large number of alien long-range soldiers.

The three-type Zerg Toxic Ray Scorpions, which are at an absolute disadvantage in terms of manpower, can only drill back into the ground to avoid attacks.

If they join the battle, it is almost like they are going to die. It is better for them to hide directly and wait for the situation to change before coming out.

The Zerg puppies are different. They have more troops and are not afraid of consumption. They only want to temporarily block the speed of the alien army.

Without long-range fire support, the Zerg puppies cannot defeat the organized alien army. They choose to continue to lurk underground and wait for the alien army to pass by before coming out to fight with the alien army.

A large number of Zerg puppies use this combat method to try their best to delay the attack of the alien army and consume the vitality of the alien army.

The mysterious chariot of the aliens rushing in the front, guarding a powerful five-star cavalry unit, rushed straight to the main combat position of the Zerg that was under attack by the falling of the large battlefield magic stars.

In the carriage of the mysterious chariot, the more than one hundred six-star alien mages have endured two consecutive spawning attacks from the Zerg Queen, all with painful expressions on their faces, desperately fighting against the two rapidly growing self-destructing parasites in their bodies.

At this time, a large group of five-star Zerg explosive mosquitoes have been upgraded.

The five-star Zerg explosive mosquitoes flew into the appropriate attack distance, suddenly accelerated, and swooped down like lightning towards the area guarded by the mysterious chariot.

"Pah pah pah...!"

At this moment, more than one hundred six-star alien mages in the mysterious chariot all exploded at the same time!

"Boom...!"

A large number of five-star Zerg explosive mosquitoes rushed into the guarding area of the mysterious chariot full of light attribute energy at the same time, and exploded at the same time!

This horrible explosion instantly overwhelmed all the sounds on the battlefield. The terrible energy impact even affected the large battlefield magic star fall that had not stopped over the main combat unit of the Zerg.
